cards.card_text: If she has been unfaithful to her husband, the water will bring bitter suffering: her belly will swell, her thigh will shrivel and she will become accursed among her people.
cards.verse_text: When he has made her drink the water, if she has defiled herself and been unfaithful to her husband, then the water that brings a curse will enter her and cause bitter suffering; her belly will swell, her thigh will shrivel, and she will become accursed among her people.
cards.snippet: …her belly will swell, her thigh will shrivel, and she will become accursed among her people.

cards.card_text: The LORD says someone who fails to reach a hundred will be considered accursed.
cards.verse_text: For the youth will die at a hundred years, and he who fails to reach a hundred will be considered accursed.
cards.snippet: …years, and he who fails to reach a hundred will be considered accursed.

cards.card_text: He asks, "Can I forget any longer, O house of the wicked, the treasures of wickedness and the short ephah, which is accursed?"
cards.verse_text: Can I forget any longer, O house of the wicked, the treasures of wickedness and the short ephah, which is accursed?
cards.snippet: …the wicked, the treasures of wickedness and the short ephah, which is accursed?

cards.card_text: Peter calls them accursed children with hearts trained in greed.
cards.verse_text: They are accursed children with hearts trained in greed.
cards.snippet: They are accursed children with hearts trained in greed.
